summary: Refuse SFTP incomplete-upload cleanup when its point path is a symlink or other non-directory. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: SFTP remains a disabled candidate; supported operator steps do not change.

api.reason: The existing uncertain-result path now refuses a symlink or non-directory point before cleanup. No route, schema, authentication or authorization change.

roadmap.reason: Corrects a safety defect in the existing SFTP publication recovery gate.

state.reason: No new durable record; Core already owns the abort marker and run/journal, and a symlink point is refused before mutation.

verification.method: Independent source review found that SFTP AbortIncomplete did not check the point path before descending. A focused authenticated SFTP regression replaced that path with a symlink and showed cleanup succeeded while deleting the target artifact before the fix; afterward Core returned ErrBackupConflict and target bytes were unchanged. Focused race and serial full Go tests passed after the fix. Independent correction review found no further concrete defect. On a matched guarded OpenSSH build the protected two-disk control restored, both markers matched, verification and typed cleanup passed, health recovered, and the 17 catalog hashes plus four source hashes were unchanged. Forge CI remains open.
verification.limits: The regression covers a static symlink path. No symlink was injected through a public Core lab operation. Exclusive ownership of the destination root is assumed; a separate writer replacing paths concurrently is outside this bounded proof.
